data.info:
type: INPUT
ports: entry, out_spec, out_lang, out_max_cycles, out_check_closure
data.label: wf_entry

data.info:
type: GENERATE
procedure_ref: procedures.analyze_spec
model: ollama/gemma3
ports: trigger, complete, in_spec, out_analysis
data.label: analyze

data.info:
type: EVALUATE
condition: contains(@in_analysis, '[READY]')
ports: trigger, pass, fail, in_analysis
data.label: spec_gate

data.info:
type: RECOVER
ports: trigger, halt, in_message, out_error
data.label: abort_vague

data.info:
type: LOOP
condition: NOT @test_passed AND NOT @denied AND @cycle < @in_max_cycles
ports: trigger, loop, exit, in_spec, in_lang, in_max_cycles, out_final_code, out_test_passed, out_denied
data.label: test_gated_loop

data.info:
type: GENERATE
procedure_ref: procedures.document_code
ports: trigger, complete, in_code, in_spec, out_docs
data.label: document

data.info:
type: GENERATE
procedure_ref: procedures.extract_spec
ports: trigger, complete, in_code, out_extracted_spec
data.label: extract

data.info:
type: EVALUATE
condition: @in_check_closure == TRUE
ports: trigger, pass, fail, in_check_closure
data.label: closure_gate

data.info:
type: GENERATE
procedure_ref: procedures.spec_judge
ports: trigger, complete, in_orig_spec, in_derived_spec, out_closure_report
data.label: judge

data.info:
type: CONTEXT
ports: trigger, complete, in_base, in_appendage, out_merged
data.label: merge_docs

data.info:
type: OUTPUT
ports: trigger, exit, in_result
data.label: wf_exit

data.info:
type: GENERATE
procedure_ref: procedures.generate_code

data.label: loop_gen

data.info:
type: GENERATE
procedure_ref: procedures.review_code
ports: trigger, complete, in_code, in_lang, out_feedback
data.label: loop_rev

data.info:
type: GENERATE
procedure_ref: procedures.improve_code
ports: trigger, complete, in_code, in_feedback, out_improved_code
data.label: loop_imp

data.info:
type: SOLVE
procedure_ref: procedures.test_code
ports: trigger, complete, in_code, in_spec, out_result
data.label: loop_test

data.info:
type: EVALUATE
condition: contains(@in_result, '[PASSED]')
ports: trigger, pass, fail, in_result
data.label: loop_eval

data.info:
type: GUARD
policy_ref: policies.mutation_safety
ports: trigger, allow, deny, in_cycle, in_max_cycles
data.label: loop_guard
